messages:
lina-cs: heads up — customer Northbridge reporting checkout failures after yesterday's sys-prompt tweak. /charge returns 400: schema validation fail. amount is \"12.00 USD\" (string) but function expects number. theyre P1.

tom-eng: can you paste the request + function schema that hit our tool layer?

lina-cs: redacted request:
```
POST /v1/chat
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-chat-16k\",
  \"messages\": [
    {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": \"Assistant: examples below. Charge amount as human text: USD 12.00 or $12.00. Use natural language in examples.\"},
    {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"Charge order #9001\"}
  ],
  \"functions\": [
    {\"name\": \"charge\", \"parameters\": {\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"amount\":{\"type\":\"number\"},\"currency\":{\"type\":\"string\"}}}}
  ]
}
```

lina-cs: model response that triggered the call:
```
assistant: calling function charge
{ \"amount\": \"12.00 USD\", \"currency\": \"USD\" }
```

lina-cs: model basically copied the humanized sys-example into the fn args instead of emitting a numeric amount.

rachel-ml: this is classic example-shadowing. sys prompt examples are influencing surface form. model prefers the tokenization seen in sys examples and ignores function param type. we saw similar with date strings previously.

devx-bot: quick mitigation: deploy server-side unary validator for function args. if amount is string and matches currency regex, try to coerce (strip letters/prefix/suffix) to number; else return 409 with guidance asking the model to resend numeric amount. Feature: coerce_amount: true.

ops-oncall: plan:
- rollback sys-prompt change for hosted customers (rollback window ok)
- hotfix validation/coercion in tool adapter (fast patch)
- add prompt lint rule to detect humanized-numeric examples in system messages
- create ENG ticket for ML alignment

tom-eng: repro steps for ML/QA:
1) add a system example with humanized number (USD 12.00)
2) call chat with function schema expecting number
3) observe model returning string amount

# curl repro (dev):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{
  "model":"redwood-chat-16k",
  "messages":[{"role":"system","content":"Examples: Charge USD 12.00 to a card."},{"role":"user","content":"Charge acct 42"}],
  "functions":[{"name":"charge","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"number"}}}}]
}'
```

rachel-ml: two-pronged fix: 1) remove/replace humanized examples with machine-readable examples (use raw numbers and explicit JSON fn-call examples). 2) add a few-shot adapter that biases outputs to match declared param types (numeric tokens when type=number).

billing: customer reported duplicated retries due to failed formatting — billing team needs request IDs and time window. lina-cs can you include req ids and whether retries were billed? mark for review.

lina-cs: adding req ids: req_nb_1a2b..., req_nb_1a2c... Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/6120 — marked P1. customer accepted temporary workaround: server-side flag prefer_function_schema=true and we unblocked them.

infra-bot: deploy log: sys-prompt change by @ryan-prod at 2026-03-16T21:47:02Z applied to hosted-global. Dedicated unaffected.

tom-eng: follow-ups: add pre-call schema check (reject + ask model to reformat) and post-call sanitizer that can coerce safely when pattern matches. also add telemetry: function_schema_mismatch metric and a small alert.

devx-bot: PR opened: devx/linters#142 — rule: "no-humanized-numbers-in-sys-examples". CI will block merges that include currency words in fewshots.

rachel-ml: note for model team: we should test on both tokenization variants (e.g., "USD 12.00" vs "$12.00" vs "12,00") and ensure our adapters prefer numeric shape; file ENG-8012 for evaluation harness.

ops-oncall: assigned ENG-7890 to @tom-eng, ENG-7891 to @rachel-ml, DEVX-142 to devx team, BILL-455 to billing. monitor /charge error rate, will rollback if we see spike post-hotfix.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-6120 — P1 tool-schema-drift (system-examples -> fncall). Participants: ops-oncall, tom-eng, rachel-ml, devx.

lina-cs: closing note: customer is unblocked with prefer_function_schema=true and partial coercion. billing investigating duplicates. will reopen if further regressions. :white_check_mark:
